required_inputs.rule: Must come from structured GIS / survey / measured reconstruction data; do not trace a screenshot as primary truth.
Lock Hyde/Lombard and Leavenworth/Lombard control points from a recorded source.
Use the same explicit vertical reference as the elevation profile.
Roadway, curb, and sidewalk widths must be measured or sourced; no default widths may be accepted as Lombard truth.

hard_invariants: Keep all canonical geometry in real-world metric units.
Do not silently extrapolate elevation beyond accepted controls.
Do not use a published headline grade as a substitute for the measured switchback profile.
Do not build stairs, terraces, or buildings to compensate for an incorrect road.
